description: Confirm the baseline is green on the new feat/doomsday-cutscenes branch before any changes. Install nothing (no deps needed). Run the Python unittest suite and the Node UI test, and do one live-server probe so the implementation features start from a known-good state. This feature makes NO code changes.
steps: Confirm current branch is feat/doomsday-cutscenes (git branch --show-current). Do NOT create or switch branches.
Run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v  and confirm it ends with OK (~44 tests).

Run: node tests/test_ui.cjs  and confirm exit code 0 and that every section summary line prints (To Live UI, Round 2 UI, FEAT-003 UI, Easier-controls UI, Settings clear controls, To Live per-game clear control, Extra-games delete controls).

Create a probe script FILE under /projects/sandbox (e.g. /projects/sandbox/probe_cutscenes.sh) that starts the server with flags inside the file (python3 app.py --no-browser --port 8791 --data /tmp/cutscene_probe.json), waits ~1s, curls http://127.0.0.1:8791/ , /app.js and /style.css, prints HTTP status for each, then kills the server. Run it in ONE execute_bash invocation (do NOT type the port/host flags directly in the command string, and do NOT rely on a backgrounded server surviving across invocations).
Confirm the three curls return HTTP 200 and that / contains id="world" and #world-toggle markup, and app.js is served.
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests ends with OK and ~44 tests ran.
node tests/test_ui.cjs exits 0 with all section summary lines printed.
The live probe (run from a script file in one invocation) returns HTTP 200 for /, /app.js, and /style.css, and / contains the #world layer markup.
No source files were modified by this feature.
verification: bash /projects/sandbox/probe_cutscenes.sh (single invocation; start+curl+kill inside the file)
findings: Baseline green on branch feat/doomsday-cutscenes. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v => Ran 44 tests, OK. node tests/test_ui.cjs => exit 0, all 7 section summary lines printed (To Live UI, Round 2 UI, FEAT-003 UI, Easier-controls UI, Settings clear controls, To Live per-game clear control, Extra-games delete controls). Live probe via /projects/sandbox/probe_cutscenes.sh (single invocation, flags inside the file): GET / , /app.js, /style.css all HTTP 200; / contains id="world" and world-toggle markup. No source files modified (git status shows only the untracked .agents task-state dir). Probe script left in place for reuse by FEAT-002/FEAT-003. Env note confirmed: server start + curls + kill must be in ONE bash invocation; app.py port/host flags kept inside the script file to avoid the server-start guard.
